source.note: Face video of each sitting, at rest and after exercise. Only the camera is used.

quality.message: The camera signal was consistent in every phase.

fusion.title: Single modality — camera only
fusion.method: Fusion needs two or more co-recorded modalities; this sitting has rPPG alone

stats.label: Trusted phases
stats.hint: SNR ≥ 0 dB and POS–CHROM within 5 bpm

fusion.note: Add a thermal or ECG channel recorded at the same sitting and this becomes a fused reading.

findings.label: Reading confidence
findings.detail: Signal 12.3 dB · POS and CHROM within 2 bpm (consistent)

advice.text: No need to contact a doctor — the resting readings are within normal ranges.

assessment.disclaimer: Screening aid, not a diagnosis. Heart rate uses the standard adult resting range (50–100 bpm); a camera reading outside it asks for a rescan before any doctor visit.

pipeline.detail: Haar cascade on the first frame, 30% margin, resized to 96 px — done once in preprocessing

An independent chrominance method, used only to check POS
Spectral peak for heart rate; trusted when SNR ≥ 0 dB and the methods agree within 5 bpm
